# Role permissions (cms-admin)

## Purpose

Edits which actions and fields one role has on each subject ([access-admin flow](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md)); read-only where the rank rule forbids the edit (D6).

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). The matrix component and its rules come from `features/access`; saving replaces the role's permissions in one call.

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

Route `/roles/:roleId`, page `RolePermissionsPage`.

## Where to change what

The matrix and its rules: `features/access`.
